tasks.title: Capture repository baseline and governance
tasks.objective: Capture reproducible repository, branch, commit, worktree and GitHub governance evidence.
tasks.context: GitHub default branch is authoritative. Refresh the current branch and SHA; the pack snapshot is only a starting point.
scope: Inspect branch protection/rulesets and Pages settings where accessible
Inventory root, source, assets, workflows, scripts and package manager
preconditions: Detect default branch rather than assuming its name
tasks.prompt: Inspect Git and GitHub metadata, current branch, HEAD, tree and status. Verify default-branch protection and available required checks. Record Pages configuration if accessible. Inventory key project files and runtime. Write only `project-system/audit/**`, `project-system/state/repo-baseline.json` and task evidence. Do not touch website code, dependencies, workflows, settings or production.
acceptance_criteria: Major source areas and workflows inventoried
No website or remote settings changed
no_scope_creep: Do not enable branch rulesets in this audit
Do not infer settings from README

tasks.title: Audit engineering, architecture and deployment
tasks.objective: Map architecture and identify technical, operational, security and deployment risks.
tasks.context: Snapshot suggests React/Vite SPA, Tailwind, React Router, Framer Motion, Vitest, Playwright dependency and GitHub Pages; verify live repo.
scope: Inspect tests, build and CI/deploy workflows
Review security/privacy, CSP, headers, secrets and Worker
preconditions: Read critical files and representative components
Run existing safe validation only if environment is ready
tasks.prompt: Audit current application architecture from source and workflow evidence. Map routes, components, state, content, interactive systems, AI/Worker, browser execution, tests, build and deployment. Review privacy, security, CSP/headers, supply-chain and accessibility. Run safe existing checks without modifying repo. Record exact findings, paths, severity, unknowns and test exits.
acceptance_criteria: Risks linked to evidence and severity
no_scope_creep: Do not claim tests pass without results

tasks.title: Audit content, projects and asset provenance
tasks.objective: Assess content, personal claims, candidate projects and image assets for preservation, verification and rights.
tasks.context: Resume/profile and project data are source material, not blanket approval to publish.
scope: Classify claims and personal approval needs
preconditions: Separate repo facts from personal contribution claims
tasks.prompt: Audit content and media without publishing changes. Examine profile/resume facts, project records, external links and all image assets. Review the candidate flagship repositories and report what evidence supports technical claims. Classify claims as repository-verified, externally-verifiable, user-confirmation-required, stale or unsupported. Capture license uncertainty and missing facts.
no_scope_creep: Do not invent outcomes or metrics
Do not create any user likeness

tasks.title: Synthesize audit and prepare approval brief
tasks.objective: Deliver comprehensive audit dossier, options, risk register and Phase 1 recommendation.
tasks.context: Closes P00. All later phases require explicit approval.
tasks.prompt: Synthesize the audit into a comprehensive dossier and executive summary. Rank findings. Compare viable architecture, content model, routing and deployment alternatives against approved requirements. Recommend an option with trade-offs but do not implement or mark consequential choices confirmed. Address branch-protection and production deployment risk. Produce readiness matrix and ask user to approve P01.
acceptance_criteria: P01 remains pending until user approval
no_scope_creep: Do not modify source or production workflow
Do not mark unresolved ADR confirmed

tasks.title: Evaluate application and rendering architecture
tasks.objective: Compare plausible frontend/rendering architectures against the approved requirements.
tasks.context: Candidates include retaining/improving React+Vite and static-first Astro/React islands; neither is pre-selected.
scope: Compare SSR/prerender/static output and progressive enhancement
Migration costs, performance, maintenance and licensing
preconditions: Use current official docs and repo evidence
tasks.prompt: Research current viable architectures. Compare current React+Vite against a static-first option such as Astro with React islands, plus any clearly superior candidate. Build a criteria-based decision matrix. Use disposable isolated prototypes only if they add evidence and are in scope. Recommend, record ADR as proposed and wait for user approval before consequential implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Trade-offs and migration estimates use project evidence
ADR remains proposed until user confirms

tasks.title: Decide content model and authoring workflow
tasks.objective: Recommend a Git-friendly content and editorial model.
tasks.context: The site needs projects, writings, curated collections and spaces; low maintenance; English first; multilingual-ready.
scope: Compare MD/MDX, structured data, CMS and hybrid
Publishing lifecycle, assets, SEO and history
tasks.prompt: Compare Markdown/MDX, structured local data, headless CMS and hybrid. Recommend the simplest fit. Define schemas for projects, profile, writing, interests, experiments and assets; include draft/approval states and fact provenance. Keep proposal pending user approval.
evidence_required: Alternatives, example records and open questions

tasks.title: Decide information architecture and URL model
tasks.objective: Define routes, space boundaries, navigation and legacy URL disposition.
tasks.context: Core navigation with optional discovery paths; deliberate professional/personal gateway; separate laboratory.
scope: Clean URLs, redirects, 404 and deep links
preconditions: Existing routes are audit input only
tasks.prompt: Produce a site map and route proposal. Show core navigation, optional discovery, personal/professional gateway and lab. Map every current route to keep/redesign/redirect/retire. Validate GitHub Pages deep-link behavior and recommend URL conventions. Mark proposal for approval.
acceptance_criteria: No empty categories or route assumptions
evidence_required: Route table, references and approval states
no_scope_creep: Do not retain every old route automatically
Do not break valuable indexed routes silently

tasks.title: Define governance, branch protection and release model
tasks.objective: Translate phase authorization into practical PR, protection, deployment and recovery controls.
tasks.context: Captured main is unprotected; default branch push triggers Pages deploy after CI, workflow_dispatch also deploys.
scope: Define PR protection and required checks
Branch per phase, commit per task
preconditions: Manual GitHub settings access may be required
tasks.prompt: Produce governance/runbook. Specify branch rules, PR checks, protection of force-push/deletion, environment deployment protection, explicit release path and rollback. Reconcile current workflow triggers with phase authorization. Do not mutate GitHub settings unless a separate explicit task authorizes it.
acceptance_criteria: Old site remains live during branch development
evidence_required: Exact settings checklist and workflow evidence
no_scope_creep: Do not claim protection enabled until verified

tasks.title: Conduct curated visual research
tasks.objective: Build annotated visual references and several distinct visual directions.
tasks.context: Figma-first; artistic/eclectic atmosphere; visual-first homepage; distinct personal space.
scope: Analyze typography, composition, motion, navigation, a11y
tasks.prompt: Research broadly and curate by design principle/use case. Explain lessons and anti-patterns for each reference. Present genuinely distinct concept directions rather than superficial color variants. Record URL/access date and license limitations.
acceptance_criteria: No asset treated as licensed merely because referenced
evidence_required: Sources/dates, concept matrix and rejected options

tasks.title: Create Figma file and visual concepts
tasks.objective: Create dedicated Figma workspace and initial concept boards.
tasks.context: New Figma file is a later design deliverable; not part of initial ZIP preparation.
scope: Figma file with research/concepts/design system/prototypes pages
tasks.prompt: Using official Figma MCP/plugin only after user authentication, create dedicated Figma file and organized pages. Produce distinct homepage opening concepts and representative gateway/section frames. Record feedback/rejections. Obtain approval before finalizing production tokens.
acceptance_criteria: No concept treated as final without approval
evidence_required: Frame/page IDs, link, approval and feedback
no_scope_creep: No production code in this task

tasks.title: Refine approved direction and design system
tasks.objective: Create Figma design system and representative page designs from approved concept.
tasks.context: Shared foundations plus content-led section systems; important design decisions trace to code.
preconditions: A concept has explicit user approval
tasks.prompt: Refine only the approved concept. Define shared tokens and justified section-specific systems. Design responsive states, keyboard/focus, reduced motion and accessible equivalents. Map important Figma variables/components to proposed code tokens/components. Obtain progressive section approvals.
evidence_required: Approvals, Figma refs and deviation history
no_scope_creep: Do not force all spaces into one style

tasks.title: Implement approved technical and visual foundations
tasks.objective: Build approved app shell, tokens, routing, core primitives and progressive-enhancement baseline.
tasks.context: First implementation task; framework/content model must be explicitly approved.
preconditions: Default branch protections verified or documented approved exception
tasks.prompt: Implement approved foundations only on phase branch. Keep old production site unchanged. Add tests alongside critical behavior. Record file list and run required gates before task-level commit.
acceptance_criteria: Core content/navigation has fallback where required
evidence_required: Commit SHA, check logs, route screenshots
no_scope_creep: Do not implement later phase content

tasks.title: Implement content pipeline and navigation shell
tasks.objective: Connect validated content to navigation and editorial components.
tasks.context: Core navigation discoverable without clutter; content types remain modular.
tasks.prompt: Implement approved navigation and content pipeline. Preserve clear core paths and intentional space transitions. Add schema checks and tests. Do not publish unapproved personal content or empty categories.

tasks.title: Establish SEO, privacy and CI foundations
tasks.objective: Implement approved metadata, crawlability, privacy defaults and CI checks.
tasks.context: Existing metadata/sitemap/robots files and GH Pages workflows need architecture-aware review.
preconditions: No API secrets in client artifact
tasks.prompt: Implement only approved SEO/privacy/CI baseline. Verify actual GitHub Pages behavior; do not rely on unsupported _headers. Keep deploy blocked until explicit release authorization. Validate each published route.
no_scope_creep: No production trigger change outside scope

tasks.title: Build flagship case studies
tasks.objective: Create a few evidence-backed editorial case studies.
tasks.context: Candidates: Coding-For-MBA, Attendance Management System using Face Recognition, Programming-Challenges-5; sequence follows audit evidence.
tasks.prompt: Build only sufficiently evidenced case studies. Explain context, constraints, decisions, implementation, outcomes and limitations. Cite repository/public evidence. Request user approval for personal role claims or opinions.
no_scope_creep: Do not exaggerate role or impact
Do not infer ownership from commits alone

tasks.title: Build profile, resume and contact
tasks.objective: Present verified professional profile and contact paths.
tasks.context: Keep minimal background; email, GitHub, LinkedIn, Instagram; select resume format after review.
tasks.prompt: Implement only approved facts. Verify date-sensitive credentials, role/title/date and contact URLs. Choose most usable resume presentation. Protect forms without adding visitor tracking.
acceptance_criteria: No expired certification presented as current

tasks.title: Build professional discovery and search
tasks.objective: Connect case studies, selected projects and writing into useful discovery.
tasks.context: Few deep case studies; other material lighter; search should not be an exhaustive tag dashboard.
preconditions: Facts approved and content system stable
tasks.prompt: Build professional discovery using approved content. Search/filter must be accessible, helpful and lightweight. Prefer static links/previews over third-party embeds unless value is proven.
no_scope_creep: Do not list every old repo automatically

tasks.title: Build personal-space gateway and shell
tasks.objective: Implement distinct personal area and intentional transition.
tasks.context: Personal space public but selectively curated; navigation and art direction differ.
tasks.prompt: Implement approved gateway and personal shell. Maintain distinct navigation and coherent underlying accessibility. Publish only curated, approved material.
evidence_required: Figma refs, screenshots, user content approval
no_scope_creep: No mandatory personal path for professional visitors

tasks.title: Build art, books, music and culture collections
tasks.objective: Create curated content-led cultural collections.
tasks.context: Presentation adapts to subject; no generic blog/feed; user interpretations are not facts.
tasks.prompt: Implement selected collections only after user approves material. Use contextual presentation, verify facts, attribute media and use static links when embeds add little.
evidence_required: User content approvals and source/license links
no_scope_creep: Do not reproduce copyrighted work beyond rights

tasks.title: Build selected learning, tech and business collections
tasks.objective: Create meaningful collections only where original/curated content is ready.
tasks.context: Technical work is already covered by project stories; personal collections should add distinct value.
tasks.prompt: Evaluate which interests have enough material. Build modular selected collections, linking to professional projects where useful. English launch; keep schema locale-ready without adding translations.
no_scope_creep: Do not fill all seven areas to satisfy checklist

tasks.title: Build curated experimental laboratory
tasks.objective: Implement selected prototypes and experiments in a clearly separate lab.
tasks.context: Curated experimentation, not exhaustive playground; sandbox safety mandatory.
tasks.prompt: Select experiments with real explanatory or interaction value. Isolate execution and user input. Provide accessible path for essential content and label experimental status.
acceptance_criteria: Essential content accessible without advanced interaction
no_scope_creep: Do not bulk-import legacy game collection
Do not expose secrets or execute unsafe untrusted code

tasks.title: Build justified visualizations and explainers
tasks.objective: Add data-driven experiences only when they improve understanding.
tasks.context: Visualization optional/context-specific; no charts merely because user works in analytics.
scope: Define user question and intended insight
preconditions: Specific approved use case and data rights
tasks.prompt: For each proposed visualization, state the question, provenance, limitations and intended insight. Choose simplest effective rendering method. Provide accessible equivalent and validate responsiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Every chart answers a documented question

tasks.title: Verify progressive enhancement and accessible equivalents
tasks.objective: Ensure all important experiences have equivalent accessible routes.
tasks.context: Every significant interaction must retain essential content/functionality access.
tasks.prompt: Inspect all advanced components. Test keyboard, screen readers, focus, motion, touch and failure. Ensure essential content/functionality is available equivalently. Document remaining limitations.
acceptance_criteria: No critical path depends on inaccessible motion/canvas
Core content survives missing JS where feasible
no_scope_creep: Do not waive blockers for aesthetic ambition
Automated pass is not proof of WCAG conformance

tasks.title: Complete cross-browser and responsive regression
tasks.objective: Verify critical routes/journeys across evergreen browsers and viewport classes.
tasks.context: Support modern Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge across mobile/tablet/desktop representative devices.
tasks.prompt: Execute browser matrix; compare snapshots against approved Figma baselines. Investigate mismatch before updating goldens. Record browser/OS/viewport and coverage gaps.
acceptance_criteria: Critical routes work directly and in-app
evidence_required: Browser versions, traces, screenshots and resolved diffs
no_scope_creep: Do not drop a browser without justification

tasks.title: Finalize performance budgets
tasks.objective: Measure representative routes and meet documented budgets.
tasks.context: Ordinary pages strict lightweight; immersive experiences may have evidence-backed exceptions.
tasks.prompt: Measure routes and representative device conditions. Set evidence-based budgets and optimize assets/fonts/scripts/animation. Document immersive exceptions with explicit budget and rationale.
no_scope_creep: Lab score does not replace real user/field evidence

tasks.title: Complete security, privacy and supply-chain review
tasks.objective: Verify release candidate security and privacy posture.
tasks.context: Security/privacy/factual integrity highest priority; no analytics/tracking; server-side credentials only.
preconditions: Release candidate and deploy config stable
tasks.prompt: Review dependencies, secrets, Actions, host security headers, Worker, forms, sandbox, input handling and third-party requests. Verify client build contains no API keys. Fix or block severe findings.
no_scope_creep: No credential rotation without authorized task
Do not overclaim GH Pages headers

tasks.title: Complete factual, editorial, SEO and creative review
tasks.objective: Evaluate content and experience against approved product/design/quality standards.
tasks.context: Qualitative creative design review complements automation.
tasks.prompt: Conduct structured creative/editorial review. Compare pages to Figma, audit claim evidence, asset rights and SEO. Record strengths, defects, deviations, limitations and release blockers.
evidence_required: Figma refs, route screenshots, source/approval links
no_scope_creep: Do not hide defects to meet target
Do not treat creative scores as automated facts
Do not claim WCAG conformance without comprehensive assessment

tasks.title: Release, verify and close project
tasks.objective: Deploy only authorized scope, verify live production and deliver evidence-based handover.
tasks.context: Autonomous deployment only within explicit release-authorized scope and after all gates.
preconditions: Branch protection and PR checks verified
tasks.prompt: Release only the approved scope. Confirm current branch rules, CI and PR. Preserve known-good deployment. Verify Pages workflow and live site, including critical routes, metadata and interactions. Roll back on defined trigger. Synchronize records and close only when accepted.
evidence_required: PR/merge SHA, workflow URL, timestamp, screenshots and smoke test results
no_scope_creep: No closure while mandatory gates fail
